name: Draggable
description:
Any element as a draggable object. Without a DragHandle inside, the whole element is the
handle: it takes focus, lifts with Space or Enter and, on touch, with a short press so the
list still scrolls. Buttons, links and fields inside keep their own behaviour. Inside a
sortable DropZone it is one of the zone's ordered items. While it is dragged it carries
`data-dnd-source` and its place stays reserved; `data-dnd-item` marks it for styling.
signature: <T = unknown>({ id, type, data, label, disabled, effect, preview, onDragStart, onDragEnd, render, className, children, ...rest }: DraggableProps<T>): ReactElement<unknown, string | import("react").JSXElementConstructor<any>>

props.name: children
props.description: The item's content, or a function of its drag state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not draggable; a string says why (aria-disabled with the reason as its description).

props.name: effect
props.description: "copy" leaves the source in place. Default "move".

props.name: id
props.description: Unique within the provider; also the item's id in every event.

props.name: label
props.description: A short name for announcements and the handle's accessible name.

props.name: liftKeys
props.description:
Keys that lift the item from its handle. Default Space and Enter. Leave Enter out when the
handle also opens something (an event that Enter opens), and say so in its description.

props.name: onDragEnd
props.description: This item's drag ended, dropped or cancelled.

props.name: preview
props.description: Content for the drag preview instead of a copy of the element.

props.name: render
props.description: The element to render instead of a div (`<li />`, `<article />`).

props.name: type
props.description: The kind of object, for zone filters. Default "item".

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
